info.title: OpenConnector Register
info.description: Integration platform register for the OpenConnector Nextcloud app. Manages Sources (outbound integrations), Endpoints (inbound API), Consumers (subscribers), Event/EventMessage/EventSubscription (event bus), Job/Mapping/Rule (workflow engine), Synchronization/SynchronizationContract (sync triad), and the four log schemas (CallLog, JobLog, SynchronizationLog, SynchronizationContractLog).

x-openregister.description: OpenConnector data model — thin client on OpenRegister; 22 schemas (14 mutable config + 4 append-only log + 4 registered-but-previously-uncounted: peppol_transmission, bankfeed_connection, and bankfeed_batch were declared in components.schemas but missing from the register's schemas list — fixed alongside the notifynl-sms-channel addition, which also adds sms_message) + payment_intent (live-payment-providers connector) + openformulieren_form_mapping/openformulieren_submission (open-formulieren-intake connector — the latter declares x-openregister-handoff targeting ns#Case). Replaces the 15 hand-rolled lib/Db/<Entity>Mapper.php classes shipped pre-chain-B.

openconnector.title: OpenConnector
openconnector.description: Integration platform register — Sources, Endpoints, Consumers, Events, Jobs, Mappings, Rules, Synchronizations, Peppol Transmission, Payment Intent, LTI 1.3 (Platform/Tool/Deployment) + 4 log schemas.

source.title: Source
source.summary: An outbound integration target (HTTP API, database, or service)
source.description: A Source is the integration counterpart for inbound or outbound data exchange. It defines the connection (location, auth, headers) and operational state (rate limits, retention, last-call timestamps). One half of the Source/Synchronization/Contract triad — see local ADR-005.

type.description: Source kind dispatched at runtime by CallService. Recognised types: 'api' (default HTTP), 'database' (DB query), 'file' (filesystem), 'soap' (SOAPService dispatch), 'dso' (Digitaal Stelsel Omgevingswet via DSOAdapterService), 'peppol' (Peppol Access Point, dispatched directly by PeppolTransmissionService — not via CallService), 'psd2' (PSD2 AIS aggregator, dispatched directly by BankfeedSyncService — not via CallService), 'sms' (SMS channel — NotifyNL or sandbox, dispatched directly by SmsDispatchService — not via CallService), 'payment' (live payment provider — log/sandbox or Mollie — dispatched directly by PaymentIntentService, not via CallService), 'open-formulieren' (Open Formulieren inbound webhook signature config, verified directly by OpenFormulierenController::inbound() — not via CallService). Free-form to keep custom adapter types unblocked; CallService falls back to HTTP for unrecognised values.
type.title: Type

auth.title: Authentication Strategy

translationConfig.description: Mapping/translation hooks applied to outbound payloads

configuration.description: Free-form structured config (provider-specific). `configuration.authentication` MAY carry a `credentialRef` object — `{"credentialId": "<uuid>"}` (primary) or `{"credentialName": "<name>"}` (convenience) — to dispatch this source's calls in-process through the OpenRegister credential broker instead of embedding secrets. When `credentialRef` is present: any sibling field under `authentication` is a hard 409 config error at call time (embedded secrets are FORBIDDEN, never merged); setting both `credentialId` and `credentialName`, or an empty value, is a 409; an ambiguous `credentialName` (0 or >1 owned matches) is a 409; SOAP sources, asynchronous dispatch, and `cert`/`ssl_key` config are rejected in v1. The provider catalogue's host-lock is the sole authority for the target host — `location` remains configuration documentation. See http-call-engine spec REQ-SBC-001/002 (change source-broker-credentials). `configuration.decompress: "gzip"` (oc#97) hints that the fetched body is a gzip-compressed file (also auto-detected from a `.gz`-suffixed endpoint or an `application/gzip` response Content-Type) — gunzipped before the existing JSON/XML/JSONL parse attempts; `.tar.gz`/`.tar` archives are detected but NOT supported (logged + skipped, see synchronization-engine spec REQ-006, change bulk-gzip-jsonl-ingestion). `configuration.listMethod`/`configuration.body` (pre-existing, see decideMethod/mergeSourceConfiguration) let a source declare a static POST body template — see `sourceConfig.paginationIn` below for advancing it across pages (change post-body-pagination).

synchronization.title: Synchronization
synchronization.summary: A bidirectional or unidirectional sync between two systems
synchronization.description: A Synchronization is one half of the Source/Sync/Contract triad (see local ADR-005). It defines what to sync (sourceId/targetId), how to compare (sourceHashMapping), and per-pass state (currentPage, last-checked timestamps). The `sourceId`/`targetId` fields have an overloaded format documented inline.

sourceId.description: Polymorphic source identifier. Overloaded format: (1) numeric string `'42'` = legacy integer Source PK; (2) `register/schema` slug pair = OR-internal source; (3) UUID string = post-chain-B canonical OR identifier. Chain B's migrator branches on the format to translate (1) to (3). Cross-ref: chain-B REQ on sourceId 3-format branching.

sourceConfig.description: Source-specific configuration overrides. Notable recognised keys: `resultsPosition` (dot-path to the objects array in the response, or `_root`/`_object`); `format: "jsonl"` (oc#97) — the fetched (and, if gzip, decompressed) body is parsed as line-delimited JSON, one record per line, instead of whole-document JSON/XML — pair with `resultsPosition: "_root"` since the parsed line array IS the records list; `paginationQuery` (field name/dot-path to bump per page, default `page`); `paginationIn: "body"` (oc#94, default `"query"`) — substitutes the next page value into the source's static `configuration.body` JSON template at the `paginationQuery` dot-path instead of the query string, for POST-body sources (e.g. TED's v3 search) whose pagination cursor lives in the request body. See synchronization-engine spec REQ-006 (change bulk-gzip-jsonl-ingestion) and http-call-engine spec REQ-006 (change post-body-pagination).

peppol_transmission.summary: Audit + lifecycle record for one UBL document transmitted over the Peppol network
peppol_transmission.description: A Peppol Transmission tracks one outbound UBL document (e.g. a Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 invoice) submitted through a configured Peppol Access Point (AP), from `queued` through the AP hand-off and any inbound delivery callback. See openspec/specs/peppol-access-point-connector/spec.md#req-003-event-driven-outbound-transmission-with-status-lifecycle.

objectUri.description: Source object being transmitted, as referenced in the nl.conduction.peppol.outbound.requested event
objectUri.title: Object URI

sourceApp.description: Slug of the producing app (e.g. shillinq)
sourceApp.title: Source App

documentType.description: UBL document type slug (e.g. ubl-invoice-2.1, ubl-order-3.0)
documentType.title: Document Type

payloadFileUri.description: Reference to the UBL payload supplied by the producing app
payloadFileUri.title: Payload File URI

transmissionId.description: AP-assigned transmission id, null until the AP accepts the hand-off (MOCK-PEPPOL-<n> for the log/sandbox provider)
transmissionId.title: Transmission ID

status.description: Lifecycle state: queued (created) -> sent (AP accepted the hand-off) -> delivered|rejected (AP delivery callback) | failed (submission exception or exhausted retry budget)
status.title: Status

detail.description: Last status detail (AP reason text, exception message, or callback detail)
detail.title: Detail

attempts.description: Per-submission-attempt audit trail (the dead-letter surface for this transmission once status=failed and the retry budget is exhausted)

error.description: Transport/provider error message, or null on a successful attempt
error.title: Error Message

attempts.title: Attempts

payment_intent.title: Payment Intent
payment_intent.summary: Audit + status-lifecycle record for one payment created through a live payment provider (e.g. Mollie)
payment_intent.description: A Payment Intent tracks one payment created via POST /api/payments, from its provider-native status through webhook-verified outcome changes. See openspec/changes/live-payment-providers/specs/live-payment-providers/spec.md#requirement-payment-creation-endpoint-accepting-shillinqs-payload-contract-req-lpp-001.

sourceSlug.description: Slug of the openconnector Source used to create this payment
sourceSlug.title: Source Slug

provider.description: Provider binding used to create this payment (log = sandbox, mollie = live Mollie Payments API v2)
provider.title: Provider

providerPaymentId.description: Provider-assigned payment id (e.g. Mollie tr_xxx, or MOCK-PAY-<n> for the log/sandbox provider) — the idempotency + webhook lookup key
providerPaymentId.title: Provider Payment ID

amountValue.description: Decimal amount as a string, e.g. "10.00"
amountValue.title: Amount Value

description.description: Payment description shown to the payer
description.title: Description

method.description: Requested payment method (ideal is the default/primary NL method; creditcard, bancontact, sepadirectdebit are also accepted passthrough)
method.title: Method

redirectUrl.description: Where the payer returns to after checkout
redirectUrl.title: Redirect URL

checkoutUrl.description: Hosted checkout URL returned to the caller by the provider
checkoutUrl.title: Checkout URL

metadata.description: Opaque passthrough metadata supplied by the caller (e.g. invoiceId/depositPaymentId, administrationId, correlationId)
metadata.title: Metadata

paymentStatus.description: Last provider-native status returned by fetchPaymentStatus()
paymentStatus.title: Payment Status

lastOutcome.description: Last outcome actually emitted as a nl.conduction.payment.status CloudEvent (shillinq's PaymentReconciliationService vocabulary) — the webhook idempotency guard (REQ-LPP-005)
lastOutcome.title: Last Outcome

createdAt.description: When this payment intent was created
createdAt.title: Created At

updatedAt.description: When this payment intent was last updated (creation or webhook processing)
updatedAt.title: Updated At

bankfeed_connection.title: Bankfeed Connection
bankfeed_connection.summary: One PSD2 AIS consent linking an aggregator source to a set of authorised bank accounts
bankfeed_connection.description: A Bankfeed Connection tracks one PSD2 Account Information Service (AIS) consent from the redirect-based SCA flow (`pending`) through `active` sync to `expired`/`revoked`. It carries the non-credential `consentReference` only — consent tokens and aggregator API keys live behind the OpenRegister credential broker (`authentication.credentialRef`), never here (ADR-007). The `expiring` enum value exists for consumer-side (shillinq BankConnection) parity; the connector keeps syncing an expiring-but-valid consent and stamps `expiryWarnedAt` when the single `nl.conduction.bankfeed.consent.expiring` event has been emitted. See openspec/specs/psd2-ais-bank-feed-connector/spec.md.

connectionId.description: Stable connection identifier referenced by the synced/consent events and by the consuming app's BankConnection record
connectionId.title: Connection ID

aggregatorSourceSlug.description: Slug of the openconnector Source (type 'psd2') this consent was created through
aggregatorSourceSlug.title: Aggregator Source Slug

aggregator.description: Aggregator vendor label ('sandbox' for the log provider)
aggregator.title: Aggregator

consentReference.description: Aggregator consent/requisition id — a non-credential reference; the consent token itself is broker-held (never stored here)
consentReference.title: Consent Reference

consentGrantedAt.description: When the consent was granted (successful SCA callback)
consentGrantedAt.title: Consent Granted At

consentExpiresAt.description: PSD2 90-day SCA renewal deadline; the sync job skips the connection once passed
consentExpiresAt.title: Consent Expires At

redirectUrl.description: Return URL registered at connect time; the SCA callback only ever redirects here (open-redirect defence)
redirectUrl.title: Redirect URL

accounts.description: Authorised accounts discovered for this consent (re-discovery replaces in place, keyed by aggregator account id)

aggregatorAccountId.description: Aggregator-side account identifier used for transaction pulls
aggregatorAccountId.title: Aggregator Account ID

accounts.title: Accounts

lastSyncAt.description: Watermark of the last successful transaction pull; advanced only on success so a failed pull re-attempts the same window
lastSyncAt.title: Last Sync At

expiryWarnedAt.description: Set when the single consent.expiring event was emitted (prevents re-emitting every sweep)
expiryWarnedAt.title: Expiry Warned At

lifecycleState.description: Consent lifecycle: pending (requisition created) -> active (callback finalised) -> expired (deadline passed) | revoked (aggregator/operator revoked). 'expiring' is reserved for consumer-side parity.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

bankfeed_batch.title: Bankfeed Batch
bankfeed_batch.summary: One pulled window of bank transactions for one account of a bankfeed connection
bankfeed_batch.description: A Bankfeed Batch is the persisted result of one scheduled PSD2 AIS transaction pull for one account: the `[since, until]` window, the aggregator-normalised transaction rows, and their count. Its URI is carried as `batchUri` on the `nl.conduction.bankfeed.transactions.synced` CloudEvent so a consuming app (shillinq) can materialise CAMT.053/BankStatement records from it. See openspec/specs/psd2-ais-bank-feed-connector/spec.md#req-004-scheduled-transaction-sync-emitting-a-synced-event-with-a-batch-uri.

accountIban.description: IBAN of the account this batch covers
accountIban.title: Account IBAN

since.description: Start of the pulled window (inclusive; the previous watermark)
since.title: Since

until.description: End of the pulled window (becomes the new watermark on success)
until.title: Until

transactionCount.description: Number of transaction rows in this batch
transactionCount.title: Transaction Count

transactions.description: Aggregator-normalised transaction rows (GoCardless Bank-Account-Data booked-transaction shape)
transactions.title: Transactions

sms_message.title: SMS Message
sms_message.summary: Audit + lifecycle record for one outbound SMS sent through a configured SMS channel source
sms_message.description: An SMS Message tracks one outbound message submitted through a configured SMS channel source (NotifyNL, or the log/sandbox provider), from queued through provider acceptance and any delivery-status poll or inbound callback. See openspec/changes/notifynl-sms-channel/specs/notifynl-sms-channel/spec.md#requirement-delivery-status-polling-and-callback.

objectUri.description: Source object being notified, as referenced by the sending app (optional)
objectUri.title: Object URI

sourceApp.description: Slug of the producing app (e.g. procest)
sourceApp.title: Source App

recipientMsisdn.description: Recipient phone number, normalised to E.164 (e.g. +31612345678) before dispatch
recipientMsisdn.title: Recipient MSISDN

templateId.description: The provider templateId (or logical template name resolved via templateMapping) used for this message
templateId.title: Template ID

provider.description: The provider binding that handled this message (log|notifynl)
provider.title: Provider

providerMessageId.description: Provider-assigned message id, null until the provider accepts the send (MOCK-SMS-<n> for the log/sandbox provider)
providerMessageId.title: Provider Message ID

status.description: Lifecycle state: queued (created) -> sent (provider accepted the send) -> delivered (status poll or inbound callback) | failed (send exception or provider-reported failure)
status.title: Status

detail.description: Last status detail (provider status text, exception message, or callback detail)
detail.title: Detail

error.description: Transport/provider error message, or null on a successful attempt
error.title: Error Message

openformulieren_form_mapping.title: Open Formulieren Form Mapping
openformulieren_form_mapping.summary: Per-form mapping config: an Open Formulieren form slug's raw submitted values onto the ns#Case handoff contract fields
openformulieren_form_mapping.description: One record per Open Formulieren form, resolved by FormFieldMapper (open-formulieren-intake). fieldMapping keys are limited to title/summary/channel (mandatory) and priority (optional) -- source is engine-filled by OpenRegister's own handoff dialect and requester is unsupported in v1 (no OR-managed party register to resolve a BSN/KvK auth context against). See openspec/changes/open-formulieren-intake/specs/open-formulieren-intake/spec.md#requirement-per-form-mapping-onto-ns-case-contract-fields-req-002.

formSlug.description: The Open Formulieren form slug this mapping applies to (unique lookup key)
formSlug.title: Form Slug

formUuid.description: The Open Formulieren form uuid, if known (informational; formSlug is the lookup key)
formUuid.title: Form UUID

description.description: Admin-facing note describing this form's mapping
description.title: Description

fieldMapping.description: Contract field name (title|summary|channel|priority) -> {type: from|const|template, value: string}. Every mandatory field (title/summary/channel) MUST be a key. A declared from/template entry whose referenced key is absent at submission time errors (MappingResolutionException) rather than leaking the literal expression -- see design.md.
fieldMapping.title: Field Mapping

isEnabled.description: Whether this mapping is active. A submission for a formSlug with no enabled mapping fails closed (status=failed).
isEnabled.title: Enabled

openformulieren_submission.title: Open Formulieren Submission
openformulieren_submission.summary: Lifecycle + audit record for one Open Formulieren submission, from receipt through mapping to a ns#Case handoff
openformulieren_submission.description: One record per inbound, signature-verified Open Formulieren submission (open-formulieren-intake). status tracks received -> mapped -> handed_off | failed, isolated per submission. Declares the submission-to-case handoff (x-openregister-handoff) targeting https://openregister.app/ns#Case, executed only by an authenticated caller via POST /api/open-formulieren/submissions/{id}/handoff -- OpenRegister's HandoffService v1 has no system-user privilege lane, so this is never triggered automatically at webhook-receipt time. See openspec/changes/open-formulieren-intake/specs/open-formulieren-intake/spec.md.

formUuid.description: The Open Formulieren form uuid, if present
formUuid.title: Form UUID

submissionUuid.description: Open Formulieren's own submission uuid (idempotency/audit reference)
submissionUuid.title: Submission UUID

submittedAt.description: ISO 8601 submission timestamp as reported by Open Formulieren
submittedAt.title: Submitted At

rawValues.description: The raw submitted field values as received (audit only -- never sent to the Case; see mappedTitle/mappedSummary/mappedChannel/mappedPriority for the normalised fields)
rawValues.title: Raw Values

authContext.description: Optional {plugin, bsn, kvk} DigiD/eHerkenning auth context. Never logged. requester is not mapped in v1 (see design.md).
authContext.title: Auth Context

mappedTitle.description: Normalised ns#Case title, resolved by FormFieldMapper
mappedTitle.title: Mapped Title

mappedSummary.description: Normalised ns#Case summary, resolved by FormFieldMapper
mappedSummary.title: Mapped Summary

mappedChannel.description: Normalised ns#Case channel, resolved by FormFieldMapper
mappedChannel.title: Mapped Channel

mappedPriority.description: Normalised ns#Case priority, resolved by FormFieldMapper when the form mapping declares it (optional contract field)
mappedPriority.title: Mapped Priority

attachments.description: Per-attachment fetch/store outcome: {key, filename, status: fetched|failed, fileId?, error?, copiedToCase?}
attachments.title: Attachments

status.description: Lifecycle state: received (persisted, unmapped) -> mapped (FormFieldMapper succeeded) -> handed_off (authenticated handoff trigger succeeded, set by OpenRegister's own onSuccess.set) | failed (mapping or handoff error, isolated to this submission)
status.title: Status

errorDetail.description: Failure detail when status=failed (secret-free, no raw BSN/KvK)
errorDetail.title: Error Detail

correlationId.description: The handoff engine's correlation id, set after a successful handoff
correlationId.title: Correlation ID

targetCase.description: {register, schema, uuid} of the created Case, set after a successful handoff
targetCase.title: Target Case

lti_platform.title: LTI Platform
lti_platform.summary: An external LTI 1.3 Platform (LMS) that may launch into this instance — this instance acts as Tool
lti_platform.description: An lti_platform row describes an external Platform (e.g. a Moodle-based state platform) that launches a signed id_token INTO this instance via OIDC third-party-initiated login. This instance acts as Tool for every launch under this registration. See openspec/changes/lti-13-platform/specs/lti-platform/spec.md#req-lti-001.

name.description: Human-readable registration name shown in the Beheer > Authenticatie registration list
name.title: Name

kid.description: Key ID published in the JWKS document and the JWS header

publicJwk.description: Public JWK (RFC 7517), published verbatim on the /.well-known/lti/.../jwks.json endpoint for active/previous keys
publicJwk.title: Public JWK

Scoped per-registration, never instance-wide — see design.md D3/D8. Custody: plaintext-pending-encryption per ADR-007 (same as every other Source secret field).

privateKeySecret.description: Private key material (plaintext-pending-encryption, ADR-007 status quo — never logged, never returned on a read surface)

rotatedAt.title: Rotated At

lti_deployment.title: LTI Deployment
lti_deployment.summary: Links exactly one lti_platform OR one lti_tool registration to a consuming-app placement
lti_deployment.description: An lti_deployment is the complete, self-describing placement contract a consuming app registers to place an external tool or expose its own content: the LTI deployment_id claim value, where a validated launch redirects, and where AGS/NRPS data is read from/published to. See openspec/changes/lti-13-platform/specs/lti-platform/spec.md#req-lti-010.

deploymentId.description: The LTI `deployment_id` claim value this deployment matches at launch/service-token time
deploymentId.title: Deployment ID

ltiPlatformId.description: FK to the lti_platform this deployment belongs to (mutually exclusive with ltiToolId — REQ-LTI-001 scenario 2; onDelete=CASCADE)
ltiPlatformId.title: LTI Platform

ltiToolId.description: FK to the lti_tool this deployment belongs to (mutually exclusive with ltiPlatformId — REQ-LTI-001 scenario 2; onDelete=CASCADE)
ltiToolId.title: LTI Tool

launchTargetUrl.description: Where a validated launch redirects the browser (Tool role), carrying a single-use launch reference
launchTargetUrl.title: Launch Target URL

gradeSink.description: ADR-008 targetType/targetId pair naming the register/schema the consuming app expects AGS-derived scores to eventually land in via its OWN event_subscription to nl.conduction.lti.ags.score.received. The adapter never writes here directly (REQ-LTI-007).
gradeSink.title: Grade Sink

rosterSource.description: ADR-008 targetType/targetId pair the adapter reads from directly to serve NRPS roster requests synchronously (REQ-LTI-009)
rosterSource.title: Roster Source

mappingId.description: Mapping slug applied to both the AGS event payload and the NRPS response shape
mappingId.title: Mapping

lti_identity_link.title: LTI Identity Link
lti_identity_link.summary: A (ltiPlatformId, subject) to Nextcloud userId mapping resolved after a launch is already cryptographically validated
lti_identity_link.description: An lti_identity_link row records how a specific lti_platform's verified sub claim maps to a Nextcloud userId (REQ-LTI-012). Keyed on (ltiPlatformId, subject) — never on subject alone, because a bare sub string has no meaning outside its issuing platform. Created either manually (an admin links an existing account) or automatically (identityPolicy: autoProvisionAsRole, bounded to defaultProvisionGroup). Identity resolution runs strictly after LtiLaunchService::validateLaunch() has already accepted the launch and never influences that trust decision. See openspec/changes/lti-tool-provider-role/specs/lti-platform/spec.md#req-lti-012.

ltiPlatformId.description: FK to the lti_platform whose verified id_token issued this subject (scopes the subject value — the same sub from two different platforms MUST NOT collide; onDelete=CASCADE)
ltiPlatformId.title: LTI Platform

subject.description: The verified id_token's sub claim value, scoped to ltiPlatformId
subject.title: Subject

userId.description: The Nextcloud userId this (ltiPlatformId, subject) pair resolves to
userId.title: Nextcloud User ID

provisioningMethod.description: How this link was created: manual (an admin linked an existing account, e.g. via OR's generic object API) or auto (provisioned under identityPolicy: autoProvisionAsRole)
provisioningMethod.title: Provisioning Method

linkedByUserId.description: The admin's Nextcloud userId that created this link; set only for provisioningMethod: manual
linkedByUserId.title: Linked By User ID

linkedAt.description: Timestamp this link was created (manual linking) or the subject was first provisioned (auto)
linkedAt.title: Linked At
